question: Should `TOOL_PROGRESS_KIND` and `isToolProgressPayload` become supported public Plugin SDK contract, or should this bundled Codex-to-Slack signal use a narrower existing reply-payload seam?
rationale: The runtime bug has a mechanical fix, but the PR also intentionally expands third-party API to connect two bundled plugins; repository policy makes that permanent contract direction an owner decision.

options.title: Approve generic progress intent
options.body: Keep the additive generic kind and predicate after fixing native-block propagation and adding focused SDK and Slack regression coverage.

options.title: Use a narrower seam
options.body: Rework the bundled producer-to-channel signal through an owner-approved contract that does not add new public callable API.

recommendation.title: Approve generic progress intent
recommendation.body: Keep the additive generic kind and predicate after fixing native-block propagation and adding focused SDK and Slack regression coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history shows the strongest ownership signal across both Slack structured delivery and Plugin SDK surface reduction.
